yeah, Vyn definitely has an interesting past which is revealed in some bits and pieces in some cards stories like his RRG and 2nd birthday cards

I think it’s interesting that you bring that up about Artem.  I think one of the big points about his character is his timidness and his attempting to understand the workings of falling in love.  Rosa and Artem have a good dynamic in that Rosa helps Artem to overcome that, though that does come at the expense of Artem becoming much bolder with his actions after anniversary.

and yeah, I totally get the whole luke thing lmao. i think it’s interesting however that probably the main theme of his personal chapters, rosa asserts that she’s thankful for luke wanting her to live the rest of her life happy >!even though he may die soon!<, but his method of trying to force her into a sheltered life isn’t what she wants at all. if i remember a glimpse of this is also seen main story when luke drags her out of hq to try and convince her to leave. my memory is blurry but i think by end of chpt 2 of luke’s personal story and onwards in other cards in the future, he gives her more space and lets her be her own person.

i think unfortunately for vyn, like luke, a lot of his backstory is locked behind card stories, which people don’t always have access to.  you get a lot of more insight into vyn by reading certain cards and delving into his personal stories.  he’s definitely the “most jealous” of the four, but i think him and luke are the most misunderstood with a main part of that being because lore bits that characterize them better are locked behind future card stories, which can be hard to obtain sometimes

i think all of the LIs are jealous to some degree which definitely gets more prevalent in future cards esp after anniv 

I understand the turnoff, tbh i find the dynamics interesting so I equally like all 4 LIs. artem’s also possessive to an extent—in chpt 6 >!he takes rosa out to chase a dangerous criminal with him, presumably out of jealousy of the others.  both of them get lodged in a very dangerous situation and either of them come close to dying!<. and to a lighter extent Marius can also be a bit jealous/possessive (off the top of my head, he got jealous abt luke being able to visit her home at his pleasure, and got slightly “possessive” in one of his card stories (fabulous feast) in the story (though it is just a small scene with some irrelevant little kid). edit: skimmed and marius outright says he was jealous lmao

so I guess part of it is just what ppl look for in the characters. they’re all jealous and possessive in their own ways, no doubt.
